$comment: The extensions catalogue: what File ▸ Extensions… offers. This is the copy the build ships, so the dialog is correct offline; the live index lives in `idossha/tetravox-extensions` and a release refreshes this file. Files are content-addressed — `url` is the file's own sha256 on the module repository's release, the same SlicerDataStore layout `sample-catalog.json` uses — and `packages/app/src/main/module-store.ts` refuses a mismatch. `permissions` is a redundant copy of what the manifest implies, so a card can be drawn without downloading anything; the consent sheet always shows the *installed* manifest's derived list.

modules.title: sEEG contacts
modules.summary: Localise and edit stereo-EEG contacts on a registered CT, and write the BIDS electrodes table back.
modules.description: A contact editor for stereo-EEG depth electrodes. Open a registered CT and the BIDS electrodes.tsv localised on it, snap contacts onto the metal, re-fit and renumber shafts, and save the table back with a timestamped backup and a seegprep-compatible editlog. Reproduces the 3D Slicer SEEG Contact Editor workflow in Tetravox's own panes, and every panel action is also a job-file operation.
modules.author: idossha

permissions: Write .tsv files you name in a Save sheet
Write {name}.{stamp}.bak beside the file you save
Write {stem}_editlog.json beside the file you save
Bind the keys Delete, Shift+s, Shift+z, a, d, f, g, n, p, s, t, z while it is active
Run from a job file: delete, flip-tip, ghost, load, refit, renumber, revert, save, size, snap, stats, wire
Store its own data inside a saved scene
